title: Inference Economics Ops Pulse: initiative tracker for batching, caching, and quantization pilots
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Objective: Create a cross-functional tracker that consolidates field pilots for batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization into a single visible initiative. Purpose is to accelerate validated unit-economics wins, establish rollout gating criteria, and produce repeatable runbooks for Dedicated and Private customers. Scope: 3 pilot types (dynamic batching heuristics, adaptive KV ttl/pinning, mixed-precision + 4-bit quant profiles). Owners: PM (Sofia Martinez), Eng leads (Ethan Chen for runtime, Priya Rao for infra), Applied ML (Marco Diaz). Deliverables: experiment matrix, standardized eval prompts, per-customer impact estimates, dashboards, rollout checklist, and post-rollout monitoring playbook.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Unified experiment matrix with clear hypotheses for each pilot (latency, cost/unit, quality). 2) Dashboard that computes cost-per-1M tokens and fwd latency P99 for each variant. 3) At least two production canaries (hosted + dedicated) with automatic fallback. 4) Rollout playbook with rollback thresholds and monitoring queries. 5) One validated + safe quantization profile that meets quality guardrails on eval set.

experiment_matrix: Batching: static batch sizes [1,4,8,16] vs adaptive queued-window; knobs: max-wait-ms, max-batch-size; hypothesis: adaptive reduces cost 8-18% with <10% p99 latency regressions
KV Cache: TTL strategies [short:10s, medium:60s, long:300s] + prefix pinning for repeated sessions; hypothesis: medium TTL reduces token generation by 12% for chat-heavy workloads

Quantization: FP16 -> 4-bit mixed precision with per-layer calibration; profiles: q4_0, q4_1, q2_5 experimental; hypothesis: q4_1 reduces GPU memory and increases throughput with <2% quality drop on customer evals
rollout_plan: Stage 0: internal canary on non-prod (1 host). Stage 1: progressive canary to 5% traffic for hosted API with automatic fallback to baseline model variant. Stage 2: Dedicated pool trial with one select customer (opt-in) and telemetry verification. Stage 3: Full rollout with release notes and opt-out controls for Private installs. Rollback triggers: quality regression >3% on eval or customer complaints grouped >2 within 30 minutes, P99 latency increase >30% vs baseline, or cost anomaly >40% in 1h.
